audits.proof: The validated cell 0 passes the clue/entry/notes predicate. cell-- then yields only negative indices, always below 81. Strict plain copied arrays and the givens string have no negative properties, so both truthy conjunctions remain false. Floating-point precision eventually stalls at a negative counter rather than restoring progress. No callback or node/abort budget exists in this synchronous loop.
audits.projectContract: Persistent snapshot decoding must terminate after validating exactly 81 cells.
audits.testPremise: Any otherwise valid attempt whose cell 0 satisfies the original clue/entry/notes contract.
audits.progressInvariant: Original cell starts 0, increases by 1 and reaches 81; mutant decreases by 1 and can never reach 81.
